question: How does any object first appear in reflective awareness?
premises: Anything reflected on may be internal or external.
Before full articulation, it appears in an unopened form.
This unopened appearance is the first shining forth.
inference: All reflective cognition begins with an initially unopened manifestation of the object.
plain_english: Here, whatever is reflected on, whether within or without, first shines forth in an unopened form.
